description: This file defines the 'LoanChargeService' class, which manages and processes loan charges within a loan management module, including recalculations, creation, updates, payments, and associated calculations.

classes.name: LoanChargeService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for managing loan charges, including recalculations, payments, creation, updating, and associated calculations involved in loan charge processing.

methods.name: recalculateAllCharges
methods.description: Recalculates all active charges associated with a given loan and updates the loan summary accordingly.

methods.name: recalculateParticularChargesAfterTransactionOccurs
methods.description: Recalculates specific charges for a loan after a transaction, considering the transaction date.

methods.name: recalculateLoanCharge
methods.description: Recalculates a specific loan charge, updating its amount based on the calculation type and whether it is overdue or installment fee.

methods.name: makeChargePayment
methods.description: Processes a payment towards a specific charge on a loan, validating and updating charge status.

methods.name: handleChargeAppliedTransaction
methods.description: Creates and applies a transaction for a charge, setting transaction date based on input or default logic.

methods.name: createChargeAppliedTransaction
methods.description: Constructs a transaction object representing the application of a loan charge, based on charge details and transaction date.

methods.name: addLoanCharge
methods.description: Adds a new charge to a loan and recalculates related amounts and schedules, updating the loan state.

methods.name: calculateAmountPercentageAppliedTo
methods.description: Calculates the amount to which a charge percentage applies, based on the loan and charge properties.

methods.name: updateLoanCharges
methods.description: Updates the set of loan charges, handling addition, modification, and removal with recalculations.

methods.name: calculatePerInstallmentChargeAmount
methods.description: Calculates total per-installment charge amount across schedule installments.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the details of a loan charge, including due date and amount, based on a command object.

methods.name: populateDerivedFields
methods.description: Sets derived fields on a loan charge based on its calculation type and related data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Overloaded method to update charge details including due date, amount, and amount applied to, with optional transaction date.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new LoanCharge object with properties set from parameters and charge definition, including population of derived fields.

methods.name: fetchLoanChargesById
methods.description: Fetches a particular loan charge by its ID from the loan's charges.

methods.name: updateOverdueScheduleInstallment
methods.description: Updates the overdue installment schedule for a given loan charge, if it is overdue and active.

methods.name: updateInstallmentCharges
methods.description: Updates the installment-specific charges for a loan charge, recalculating them as necessary.

methods.name: generateInstallmentLoanCharges
methods.description: Generates installment charges for a loan based on a loan charge, optionally with a transaction date filter.

methods.name: calculateOverdueAmountPercentageAppliedTo
methods.description: Calculates the overdue amount percentage applied to, based on loan, installment, and charge properties.

methods.name: calculateOverdueAmountPercentageAppliedTo
methods.description: Calculates overdue amount based on the installment and calculation type.

methods.name: update
methods.description: A comprehensive method to update a LoanCharge with amount, due date, amount applied, and optionally a transaction date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Another overloaded update method to include transaction date, updating the charge accordingly.

methods.name: calculateInstallmentChargeAmount
methods.description: Calculates charge amount per installment based on calculation type and percentage.

methods.name: getTotalAllTrancheDisbursementAmount
methods.description: Sums the principal amounts of all disbursed tranches in a loan.

methods.name: fetchAllLoanChargeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all charge IDs associated with the loan.

methods.name: calculateInstallmentChargeAmount
methods.description: Calculates installment charge amount for a specific installment.

methods.name: getDerivedAmountForCharge
methods.description: Computes the derived amount for a charge based on loan, disbursement, and charge properties.
